name: Data list
description: Label / value pairs on a description list: small uppercase labels over their values, stacked or in a wrapping row.

classes.ayy-data-list--row: Items side by side, wrapping to fit (each at least --ayy-min, default 9rem).
classes.ayy-data-list__value: The <dd>: the value, in body text.

js: dataListClass({ row?, className? }) → string; dataListItemClass, dataListLabelClass, dataListValueClass constants.
a11y: A real <dl>/<dt>/<dd>, so screen readers announce each value with its term.
Links in values keep their focus ring; external ones should say so.
do: Use a data list for facts about a thing: Role, Company, Years, Platform on a case study; plan details; file metadata.
Keep labels to one or two words.
Use the row form under a title, as the facts line of a case study.
dont: Don't use it for many records with the same fields — use Table.
Don't use it for editable settings — use Field with inputs.
Don't use it for prose; values should be short.
